name: magnetic-button
title: Magnetic Button
description: A pair of buttons with a padded hit area; when the pointer enters, the button drifts toward it and a dashed blue field lights up, springing back when the cursor leaves.
use: A hero or pricing call to action should feel tactile and invite a little play before the click.
avoid: Touch and keyboard users get none of it, and an already small target shifts away as the pointer nears.
a11y: The pull happens only on pointer move, and no focus style or reduced-motion check is added to the wrapper. (keyboard: partial, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card holds a bold white title, a short grey line and two buttons: a light filled one and a dark outlined one. A dashed blue rectangle with a faint blue wash surrounds whichever button is hovered.
behaves: Moving the pointer into a button's padded field pulls the button toward the cursor up to a set distance while the dashed outline and blue tint fade in. Leaving lets a spring carry it back to centre.
customise: Pass any children and set strength, maxDistance and the hit-area className; the spring and the blue highlight colour are fixed in the source.
weight: light: One spring transform updated on pointer move, idle the rest of the time.
